analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: Indicator Triggered for US Equity L/S; Quants Close to Trigger
key_insights: Hedge funds cut gross exposure by 2.3 std on Wednesday, 2.1 std on Thursday and 0.4 std on Friday of the prior week, with the de-grossing concentrated in Hyperscalers.
Friday's de-grossing (0.4 std) was modest relative to what the price action would have suggested.
Continued pressure in Hyperscaler names and the resulting hit to performance triggered the UBS Systematic Advisory Deleveraging Indicator for US Equity L/S strategies.
Quant strategies are close to triggering the same indicator, per the report title.
In Europe, performance pressure was similar but de-grossing was more moderate, under 1 std in each session, so the Europe indicator has not triggered.
risk_factors: Continued de-grossing in US Hyperscaler names by hedge funds, with performance pressure.
Quant strategies close to triggering the deleveraging indicator, which could extend the de-grossing.
vol_and_positioning: UBS Systematic Advisory Deleveraging Indicator triggered for US Equity L/S: gross exposure cut 2.3 std (Wed), 2.1 std (Thu), 0.4 std (Fri), concentrated in Hyperscalers.
Europe L/S de-grossing under 1 std per session, indicator not triggered. Japan indicator off.
Quant strategies are close to a trigger of the deleveraging indicator.
